primary_question: When the exact governing warrant is removed, does semantic retrieval abstain or substitute a neighboring Standard X requirement?
targets: All seven Molina Standard X Not Met elements: 6, 8, 14, 15, 18, 19, 23.
candidate_pool: Official Standard X requirement cards comprising all 16 cards from the prior SilverSummit held-out pool plus the local grievance cluster 4-8; item numbers and citations are not appended to lexical text.
query: Concise faithful transcription of HSAG Findings, with item identifiers and CFR citations excluded from query text.
conditions: removed: only exact same-item warrant removed
correct_removed_behavior: ABSTAIN; any other selected item is a false substitution.
methods: stage plus verified structured item ID

threshold_frontier.eligibility: retain at least 6/7 intact exact-and-answered targets
threshold_frontier.rule: abstain if top score < score threshold OR top1-top2 margin < margin threshold

secondary_diagnostic: Corrupt structured item identifier to nearest different candidate; report separately.
